### Reproduced
yes — on the PR #4018 preview (https://velo-pr4018.cloudflare-e53.workers.dev/admin/test1/activity), signed in as the review login with headless Chrome (Playwright), 2026-11-17 11:30 UTC. The page body reads, word for word: `Activity Log · 1 events · +0 · ~1 · -0 · Export · Collection · Operation · User · All Time · Today · Last 7 Days · Last 30 Days · Last 90 Days · Refresh · TODAY · 11:18:29 · UPDATE · pagesPages · #seed:pag... · Review Tester · 5 fields changed · Show changes · Showing 1 - 1 of 1 · Previous · Next`. That is every complaint in the ticket: English text on a French (`<html lang="fr">`) admin, the raw table key plus a cut-off id, the hand-built list, and the counters.
On staging (velo.pmcp.dev, i.e. main) the same page still shows **only the title bar**: `staging-get.mjs velo /api/teams/<team>/crouton-events?pageSize=5` → HTTP 200 · 0 rows, and the rendered panel holds just "Activité". The blank-page fix (#4018) is **still open, waiting for the owner's ok**, not merged. The ticket's "works again" is true only on that preview.
Found while reading the code: **the filters do nothing today.** `CroutonActivityLog` passes a frozen copy of its query (`useCroutonEvents(queryOptions.value)`), and `useCroutonEvents` builds its query once. Changing collection, person or period just re-fetches the same unfiltered list. A redesign that leaves this alone would ship good-looking filters that still do
